name: scroll-area

frames.best_why: Top of the list with the Releases heading and the first rows visible inside the frame.

tagline: Long release list scrolls inside a small bordered frame.
summary: A compact scroll panel holding a heading and a long list of version numbers. Content scrolls under the fixed frame, with a slim themed bar on the right instead of the browser's own scrollbar.
appearance: A narrow bordered dark panel with a small heading and a list of grey version strings separated by faint rules, plus a thin lighter bar sitting just inside its right edge.
behaviour: Wheel scrolling or dragging the slim bar moves the rows under the frame; the heading travels up with the content and disappears, and the rows pass out of sight at top and bottom.
demo_content: A Releases list of thirty version tags from v1.2.0-beta.30 down to beta.16.
search_phrases: long list in a small box
box that scrolls inside the page
thin bar to drag down a list
version history in a fixed frame
styled scrollbar instead of the browser one
small window onto a longer list
use_when: A list is longer than its frame and you want a slim, themed bar instead of the browser scrollbar.
avoid_when: The thumb is only about ten pixels wide, so it is hard to grab and drag on a touch screen.
customise: Any content goes in as children and the wrapper takes a height and width through className; bar width, thumb colour and corner are class overrides.
weight_why: One scrollable viewport with a styled thumb; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The list carries no label and the viewport has no visible focus style, so keyboard scrolling is not signposted.

issues: The Releases heading scrolls out of view with the rows, so the panel loses its title
The scroll thumb is very thin and almost the same tone as the border
polish_why: Neat compact release list; the heading scrolls away and the thumb is barely visible.
title: Scroll Area
